In Trump’s second term, his administration has laid off or pushed out more than 1,000 CISA employees, shrinking the agency by about one-third. The president’s 2027 budget proposal would reduce funding for the agency by another $700 million, which could necessitate 900 additional layoffs. [...] DOGE laid off people critical to the agency’s election work, including those who’d worked closely with states. The Trump administration cut funding for the technology that monitored web and election servers, blinding the federal government to breaches it had detected.

When it came time for states to prepare for the 2026 midterms, CISA had disappeared.

Washington DC, October 19, 2026--The LSEG/Ipsos Primary Consumer Sentiment Index for October 2026 is at 45.2, its lowest reading since October 2011. Fielded from September 25 – October 1, 2026, the Index is down 5.3 points from last month, the second-largest month-over-month decline on record, behind only April 2020.

The Index now sits below its May 2020 pandemic low (45.4) and is 7.7 points lower than its reading from this time last year.
